newsitem.title: USA: US DOE sells 775,000 bbls SPR oil for $15.813 mln.
newsitem.headline: US DOE sells 775,000 bbls SPR oil for $15.813 mln.

text.p: The U.S. Energy Department said Thursday it sold 775,000 barrels of crude oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to Basis Petroleum Inc for a total of $15.813 million.
The purchase was of 400,000 barrels for November-December pipeline delivery at $20.50 per barrel, and 375,000 barrels for November-December tanker delivery at $20.30 per barrel.
From three sales to date, 4.145 million barrels have been sold for $88.452 million in the initiative intended to raise $220 million to cover costs of maintaining the reserve, the department said.
Average price so far has been $21.34 per barrel.
The sale was of oil stored at the reserve's West Hackberry site near Lake Charles, Louisiana.
The next round of bids will be due Tuesday, November 12, with best and final offers expected two or three days later.
